This strain is also known for helping with stress and anxiety, and it can give you a solid case of the munchies, so keep some snacks nearby. It’s a versatile strain that works well for both day and evening use, depending on how much you smoke. Overall, Blue Cherry Gelato is a great choice if you’re into a flavorful strain that delivers a balanced high with both uplifting and relaxing effects. It’s a hybrid that typically blends Cherry Pie with Zkittlez, and it’s got a lot to offer. First up, the flavor and aroma are killer. Imagine a sweet, fruity cherry flavor with a hint of candy-like sweetness mixed in. It’s got a really nice, smooth taste that makes smoking it a pleasure. The smell is similarly fruity with a touch of earthiness, giving you that classic sweet-and-sour vibe. When you smoke Cherry Zashimi, you’re in for a treat. The high usually kicks off with a burst of euphoria and energy, making it great for social hangouts or creative sessions. You’ll feel uplifted and happy, which is perfect if you’re looking to enhance your mood. After a while, it transitions into a more relaxed, mellow state, so you’re not left feeling too buzzed or jittery. It’s a nice balance that makes it versatile for different times of the day. In terms of effects, Cherry Zashimi is known for giving you a good mix of mental stimulation and body relaxation. It’s not too heavy, so you won’t get couch-locked, but it still helps you unwind. Plus, it can be a nice option if you’re looking to spark up some appetite or just chill after a long day. Overall, Cherry Zashimi is a solid choice if you want a flavorful strain that gives you a happy, balanced high with a sweet twist. Terpenes Myrcene: This is usually the dominant terpene in Cherry Zashimi. It has a sweet, earthy, and musky aroma, often with a hint of fruitiness. Myrcene is known for its relaxing and sedative effects, which contribute to the mellow part of the high. It can also enhance the overall experience by providing a soothing body buzz that balances the uplifting head high. Limonene: This terpene brings a citrusy, lemon-like scent and flavor. Limonene is known for its mood-enhancing and stress-relieving properties. It adds a bright, uplifting element to the high, making it feel more euphoric and energizing. It also contributes to the sweet, fruity flavor profile of Cherry Zashimi. Caryophyllene: With its spicy, peppery aroma, Caryophyllene adds a bit of kick to the strain’s flavor. It’s unique because it can interact with the body’s cannabinoid receptors, providing potential anti-inflammatory and pain-relieving benefits. products.description: Click here for COA Jealousy strain is a well-balanced hybrid strain (50% indica/50% sativa) made by crossing two impressive strains: Gelato 41 and Sunset Sherbet. This earthy strain has exceptionally high THC levels, around 28-30%, and is perfect for experienced cannabis users. Jealousy THCa strain will bring an uplifting high that will relax you for hours. You’ll then feel creativity coming over you, energizing your brain with motivation to finish any task. On the comedown, you’ll feel a euphoric body high, leaving you happy and maybe giggly. Jealousy strain is a real standout for anyone who loves a potent, well-rounded high with a dash of luxury. This combo brings together the best traits of both parents, delivering a smooth and flavorful experience with a bit of an edge. Visually, Jealousy is striking. The buds are often dense and compact, covered in a thick layer of glistening trichomes that give them a frosty, almost diamond-like appearance. You’ll notice vibrant colors too, with shades of deep green, purple, and a touch of orange pistils that really pop. Aroma-wise, Jealousy is quite enticing. It has a rich, complex scent with strong notes of sweet, citrusy fruit, combined with hints of earthy and pine undertones. It’s like a fresh, fruity dessert with a touch of spice—inviting and intriguing. When it comes to flavor, Jealousy continues to impress. The taste is smooth and sweet, with a fruity, citrusy profile that might remind you of a sherbet or candy. There’s also a subtle earthy undertone that rounds out the flavor, making each puff delicious and satisfying. As for the effects, Jealousy delivers a balanced high that hits both your mind and body. You’ll start with an uplifting, euphoric buzz that boosts your mood and creativity, perfect for socializing or diving into creative projects. As the high progresses, you’ll experience a relaxing body effect that helps ease tension without making you too sleepy or couch-locked. Overall, Jealousy is a fantastic choice if you’re into strains that offer a rich flavor profile and a well-rounded high. It’s great for enhancing social experiences, winding down, or simply enjoying a flavorful smoke. If you’re looking for something that combines sweetness with a bit of sophistication, Jealousy is definitely worth a try! products.description: Click here for COA Permanent Marker is a pretty intriguing strain if you’re into something unique and potent. Permanent Marker is a hybrid strain; a fusion of several well-established cultivars: Biscotti x Sherb Bx x Jealousy. At 18% THC content, this is an ideal choice for moderate to experienced cannabis users! Let’s dive into the flavor first because it’s pretty distinctive. The name “Permanent Marker” gives you a hint of what to expect. The strain has a strong, pungent aroma that’s often described as being similar to a marker or diesel, mixed with some earthy and skunky notes. When you smoke it, you’ll get that sharp, chemical-like taste combined with an undertone of sweet and earthy flavors. It’s definitely not your typical fruity or floral strain—it's bold and memorable. Now, the high is where Permanent Marker really shines. It usually hits you with a heavy, relaxing buzz that starts in the head and gradually moves to the body. You’ll likely feel an initial euphoria that makes you feel happy and uplifted, but as the high progresses, it shifts into a deep, sedative relaxation. It’s the kind of strain that’s great for winding down after a long day or just chilling out. Permanent Marker is also known for its potential to help with stress, pain, and insomnia. If you’re looking to relax and kick back without feeling too energetic or jittery, this strain is a solid choice. It can also give you a serious case of the munchies, so keep some snacks handy. Overall, Permanent Marker is a great pick if you’re into bold flavors and a heavy, relaxing high. It’s got a unique profile that makes it stand out, and it provides a chill, comfortable experience that’s perfect for unwinding. Terpenes Caryophyllene: This terpene adds a spicy, peppery kick to the flavor profile. It’s unique because it can interact with the body’s cannabinoid receptors like cannabinoids do, which means it has potential anti-inflammatory and pain-relieving properties. In Permanent Marker, Caryophyllene enhances the strain’s bold, earthy notes and contributes to its heavy, relaxing effects. Myrcene: Known for its earthy, musky aroma with hints of fruit, Myrcene is often a dominant terpene in many strains, including Permanent Marker. products.description: Quattro Kush THCa Flower Strain Quattro Kush is an Indica-dominant hybrid THCa strain known for its potent effects and robust flavors. It is a cross between three notable strains: 707 Headband x Triangle Kush x SFV OG Kush. The breeders behind this strain are Ethos Genetics. Quattro Kush THCa Flower made its appearance on the market through their efforts. Indica-dominant strains are typically associated with relaxation and sedation; Quattro Kush aligns with this profile. It leans heavily towards the indica side effects, offering a calming and relaxing experience. Click here for COA Appearance The appearance of Quattro Kush buds showcases the typical traits associated with indica strains. They tend to be dense and compact, often tightly packed. The flowers are typically vibrant green in color, adorned with a generous covering of trichomes that give them a frosty appearance. The strain may also feature hints of purple or orange, adding to its visual appeal. Aroma/Flavor Quattro Kush exhibits a complex and enticing aroma derived from its parent strains. The scent is spicy and skunky, with hints of diesel inherited from the 707 Headband. The earthy scents of Triangle Kush help mellow out the overall aroma. At the same time, SFV OG Kush contributes fresher citrus and pine flavors. The flavor profile of Quattro Kush is a harmonious combination of various elements. Spicy, woody notes dominate upon inhaling, followed by a subtle sweetness reminiscent of pears, which helps balance the intensity. There are herbal undertones on the exhale with a touch of tea-like flavors. Effects Quattro Kush THCa Flower is known for its powerful effects, so users should be prepared for an intense experience. It is popular among experienced cannabis enthusiasts who seek a more potent strain. Still, it can also be enjoyed by beginners in smaller doses. As an Indica-dominant strain, Quattro Kush delivers a profoundly relaxing and calming high. Users can expect a head-emptying effect that promotes a carefree and blissful state of mind upon consumption. The strain has euphoric properties that can induce laughter and make social interactions more enjoyable. Additionally, Quattro Kush stimulates appetite, so users may experience the case of munchies. It can be an excellent choice for relaxed gatherings with friends or indulging in stoned cooking sessions. Quattro Kush is best suited for expe

products.description: Click here for COA This strain is pretty awesome if you're into potent and flavorful cannabis. It’s a Sativa-dominant hybrid strain. It is a cross between Martian Mean Green, known for its stimulating effects and fruity flavors, and Wedding Cake, loved for its relaxing effects and sweet, vanilla-like taste. With this combo, you’re looking at a nice blend of cerebral high and relaxing effects. Space Junky usually has a sweet, fruity aroma, kind of like berries with a hint of citrus. When you smoke it, you'll get a taste that matches that—think blueberries with a bit of earthy undertones. The high kicks in with a euphoric, uplifting vibe, which is great if you want to chill but still stay engaged and creative. It's perfect for kicking back with some friends, playing video games, or even tackling some creative projects. In terms of effects, it’s known for giving you a balanced high—initially, it’ll get your head buzzing and uplifted, but it doesn’t leave you couch-locked. As the high progresses, you might feel more relaxed and mellow, which makes it a good choice for both day and evening use. Overall, if you're looking for something that hits that sweet spot between relaxation and energy, Space Junky is definitely worth checking out. Terpenes Myrcene- This is often the dominant terpene in Space Junky. It has an earthy, musky aroma with hints of fruit. Myrcene is known for its sedative effects and can contribute to the strain’s relaxing, mellow vibe. It also helps in enhancing the overall high by promoting a more chill experience. Limonene- This terpene gives off a citrusy, lemony smell. Limonene is known for its uplifting and mood-enhancing effects. It can help boost your mood and provide a bit of energy, which complements the euphoric high of Space Junky. Pinene- With its fresh, piney scent, Pinene adds a bit of crispness to the aroma. This terpene is believed to have memory-enhancing and anti-inflammatory properties. It also balances out the high, providing a bit of mental clarity and focus. With these terpenes, Space Junky offers a nice blend of relaxation, mood enhancement, and mental clarity, making it a well-rounded strain for various activities.

Each batch is indoor-grown, hand-trimmed, and third-party lab-tested so you know exactly what’s in the jar before it ships. Lemon Cherry Gelato Strain Profile Lemon Cherry Gelato, often shortened to “LCG” is a slightly indica-dominant hybrid (roughly 60% indica / 40% sativa) created by crossing Sunset Sherbet with Girl Scout Cookies . That pairing is responsible for its standout looks: chunky, conical buds that run from deep green to flashes of purple, blanketed in trichomes. Spec Detail Strain type Indica-dominant hybrid (~60/40) Lineage Sunset Sherbet × Girl Scout Cookies THCA content See current COA (listed on product) Dominant terpenes Caryophyllene, Limonene, Myrcene Grow Indoor, hand-trimmed Aroma & Flavor The name is the tasting note. Lemon Cherry Gelato leads with bright lemon and ripe cherry, rolls into sweet berry and creamy gelato, and finishes with a faint earthy-pine undertone. The limonene-forward terpene profile is what gives it that citrus-candy top note, while caryophyllene adds a subtle peppery depth on the exhale. Effects & What to Expect As an indica-leaning hybrid, Lemon Cherry Gelato is generally enjoyed as a relaxed, easygoing strain, mellow and unwinding without being heavy at moderate amounts. Many users reach for it in the evening or on a low-key day off. As with any THCA flower, start low and go slow to find your own comfortable amount. products.description: Blue Dream is a sativa dominant hybrid made by crossing Blueberry and Haze. This strain known for its balanced and cerebral effects and full-body relaxation. The strain's genetics are linked to DJ Short's Blueberry and a Haze strain, resulting in a hybrid known for its harmonious effects. Blue Dream's aroma is often described as a harmonious blend of earthy, fruity, and floral notes. Green Crack THCa Flower, often referred to by the less controversial name "Green Crush" or "Mango Crack," is a potent sativa-dominant hybrid strain born from the cross of Skunk #1 with an unknown indica. With a tangy, fruity flavor reminiscent of sweet mango, Green Crack is a daytime favorite for those looking to combat fatigue, stress, and low energy. Pinene: Adds a refreshing pine scent, which may help with alertness and memory, counterbalancing the sedative qualities of Myrcene. These terpenes work together to create Green Crack's distinctive aroma and are key to its energizing and mood-enhancing properties. products.description: Strain Profile Biscotti THCA Flower is a potent indica-dominant hybrid often credited to Gelato 25 × Sour Florida OG (with some sources citing Motorbreath × Gelato 41 ). Either way, the cultivar is a modern flavor cornerstone — dense buds, deep coloring, generous trichome coverage, and a sweet cookie-like aromatic profile that rewards every step from the jar to the exhale. Effects Biscotti delivers a sneaky cerebral journey that builds gradually before settling into a relaxed, inspired, body-buzzing baseline. The high doesn't announce itself loudly — it sneaks up — making this a cultivar to dose with respect, especially for users with low tolerance. Best paired with downtime or evening use. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: sweet cookie-cream up front, with layered fuel undertones through the middle and a warm dessert finish on the exhale. Smoke is smooth and richly textured. The terpene profile reads cookie-and-gas with sweet depth — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Biscotti harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Biscotti THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Biscotti THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. 🥚 Cookie Cream indica Sweet THCA Flower Lost In Translation

products.description: Strain Profile Biscotti THCA Flower is a potent indica-dominant hybrid often credited to Gelato 25 × Sour Florida OG (with some sources citing Motorbreath × Gelato 41 ). Either way, the cultivar is a modern flavor cornerstone — dense buds, deep coloring, generous trichome coverage, and a sweet cookie-like aromatic profile that rewards every step from the jar to the exhale. Effects Biscotti delivers a sneaky cerebral journey that builds gradually before settling into a relaxed, inspired, body-buzzing baseline. The high doesn't announce itself loudly — it sneaks up — making this a cultivar to dose with respect, especially for users with low tolerance. Best paired with downtime or evening use. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: sweet cookie-cream up front, with layered fuel undertones through the middle and a warm dessert finish on the exhale. Smoke is smooth and richly textured. The terpene profile reads cookie-and-gas with sweet depth — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Biscotti harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Biscotti THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Biscotti THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. 🥚 Cookie Cream indica Sweet THCA Flower Lost In Translation

products.description: Strain Profile Black Runtz THCA Flower is a meticulously crafted indica-dominant hybrid bred from Zkittlez crossed with Gelato . The cross combines the irresistible Zkittlez candy-fruit aromatic with Gelato's creamy complexity, producing dense, dark-toned buds with deep purple expression and the trichome coverage that signals premium genetics. Effects Black Runtz delivers an uplifting euphoric experience anchored by relaxed, body-easy effects. Despite the indica lean, the high stays mood-lifting and conversational without sliding into heavy sedation — making this a versatile cultivar for late-afternoon use, social settings, or evening unwinding with flavor character intact. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: sweet candy-fruit up front (Zkittlez signature), with a creamy gelato middle and a smooth, dessert-rich finish on the exhale. Smoke is silky and unmistakably loud. The terpene profile reads candy-and-cream — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Black Runtz harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Black Runtz THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Black Runtz THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. Candy Cream Fruit indica THCA Flower Lost In Translation

products.description: Strain Profile Black Runtz THCA Flower is a meticulously crafted indica-dominant hybrid bred from Zkittlez crossed with Gelato . The cross combines the irresistible Zkittlez candy-fruit aromatic with Gelato's creamy complexity, producing dense, dark-toned buds with deep purple expression and the trichome coverage that signals premium genetics. Effects Black Runtz delivers an uplifting euphoric experience anchored by relaxed, body-easy effects. Despite the indica lean, the high stays mood-lifting and conversational without sliding into heavy sedation — making this a versatile cultivar for late-afternoon use, social settings, or evening unwinding with flavor character intact. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: sweet candy-fruit up front (Zkittlez signature), with a creamy gelato middle and a smooth, dessert-rich finish on the exhale. Smoke is silky and unmistakably loud. The terpene profile reads candy-and-cream — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Black Runtz harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Black Runtz THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Black Runtz THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. Candy Cream Fruit indica THCA Flower Lost In Translation

products.description: Strain Profile Blackberry Kush THCA Flower is a lush indica-dominant hybrid bred from Afghani crossed with Blackberry genetics. The cross delivers an exceptional flavor profile and dense, deeply colored buds with the kind of layered aromatic character that combines rich berries with sweet earth and subtle floral undertones. Effects Blackberry Kush delivers deeply relaxing, indica-leaning effects ideal for evening use. The cerebral side stays warm and pleasant; the body settles into long, comfortable ease — making this a strong cultivar for unwinding, post-work decompression, or settling in with flavor character intact. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: rich blackberry up front, with sweet earthy notes through the middle and a subtle floral finish on the exhale. Smoke is smooth and unmistakably fruit-forward. The terpene profile reads berry-and-earth — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Blackberry Kush harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Blackberry Kush THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Blackberry Kush THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. products.description: Strain Profile Blue Andies THCA Flower is a balanced hybrid that pairs sweet blueberry character with cool minty cream notes — reminiscent of the namesake mint candy. The cultivar produces dense, deeply colored buds with the kind of layered aromatic profile that combines fruit-forward sweetness with refreshing herbal depth. Effects Blue Andies delivers a balanced experience that pairs warm cerebral euphoria with comfortable body relaxation. The high feels well-rounded and pleasant — suitable for late-afternoon use, social settings, or evening flavor-led decompression — with the kind of bright character that distinguishes berry-mint hybrids. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: sweet blueberry up front, with cool mint through the middle and a creamy vanilla finish on the exhale. Smoke is smooth and unmistakably refreshing. The terpene profile reads berry-and-mint — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Blue Andies harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. products.description: Strain Profile Cake Bomb THCA Flower is an indica-dominant hybrid bred from Do-Si-Dos crossed with PCS1 . The cross delivers a richly dessert-rich aromatic profile with the dense, dark-toned bud structure Do-Si-Dos genetics are known for — visually premium, deeply flavored, structurally serious. Effects Cake Bomb delivers a potent body high complemented by calming mental euphoria. The onset is steady and the body settles fully; the head stays warmly engaged rather than racing. Best reserved for evening use, post-dinner unwinding, or any setting where flavor character paired with real depth is the appeal. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: sweet vanilla up front, with creamy cake notes through the middle and a subtle warm-spice finish on the exhale. Smoke is full and unmistakably bakery-rich. The terpene profile reads vanilla-cream-and-spice — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Cake Bomb harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Cake Bomb THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Cake Bomb THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. Cream indica Sweet Vanilla THCA Flower Lost In Translation

products.description: Strain Profile Candi Paint THCA Flower is a striking hybrid known for its bold flavor and colorful character. The cultivar produces dense, vibrantly colored buds with a richly layered aromatic profile bursting with sugary fruit, citrus candy, and a hint of floral spice layered over subtle notes of earth. Effects Candi Paint delivers a balanced experience that pairs uplifting cerebral euphoria with comfortable body relaxation. The high feels well-rounded and pleasant — suitable for late-afternoon use, social settings, or evening flavor-led decompression — with the kind of bright character that distinguishes candy-led hybrids. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: juicy berries up front, with tropical fruit through the middle and a smooth candy-floral finish on the exhale. Smoke is smooth and unmistakably bright. The terpene profile reads candy-fruit-and-floral — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Candi Paint harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Candi Paint THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Candi Paint THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. Berry Candy hybrid Tropical Fruit THCA Flower Lost In Translation

products.description: Strain Profile Candy Chrome THCA Flower is a decadent hybrid that fuses candy-like sweetness with a sleek, gassy finish. The cultivar produces dense, well-structured buds with a vibrant layered aromatic profile bursting with sugary fruit, ripe berries, and creamy vanilla glaze balanced by subtle notes of fuel and spice. Effects Candy Chrome delivers a balanced experience that pairs warm cerebral euphoria with comfortable body relaxation. The high feels well-rounded and pleasant — suitable for late-afternoon use, social settings, or evening flavor-led decompression — with the kind of contrasting character that distinguishes candy-meets-gas hybrids. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: sweet fruit candy up front, with creamy vanilla glaze through the middle and a smooth gas-spice finish on the exhale. Smoke is full and unmistakably layered. The terpene profile reads candy-vanilla-and-gas — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Candy Chrome harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Candy Chrome THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Candy Chrome THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. Candy Fruit hybrid Sweet THCA Flower Lost In Translation

products.description: Strain Profile Rainbow Runtz THCA Flower is a captivating hybrid bred from Watermelon Mimosa crossed with the renowned Runtz . The cross inherits a diverse genetic heritage — brunch-cocktail brightness from Mimosa, candy-fruit loudness from Runtz — producing colorful, frosty buds with strong bag appeal. Effects Rainbow Runtz delivers an uplifting, mood-lifting onset that pairs cerebral euphoria with a comfortable body baseline. The high feels social and pleasant, ideal for daytime use, group settings, or any moment that benefits from a steady, flavor-led hybrid that doesn't tip too far in either direction. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: ripe watermelon and citrus up front, with sweet candy through the middle and a sugary finish on the exhale. Smoke is smooth and unmistakably refreshing. The terpene profile reads tropical-fruit-and-candy — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Rainbow Runtz harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Rainbow Runtz THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Rainbow Runtz THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains. Lunch Money Strain THCa Flower – Living Soil Exotic AAA Northern California Small Batch | Private Farm Drop Cannarado Genetics crossed Money Gun with Grape Pie Bx to produce Lunch Money, and the naming is the most honest thing about the strain: it tastes like the contents of a very good lunchbox, if the lunchbox belonged to someone whose parents had significantly elevated their budget for confectionery. Ripe grape, sugared dough, and a faint earthy undertone that keeps the profile from being purely dessert. In the jar it leans dessert-first. In the break it opens into something resinous and grounded. On the palate the grape and earthy sweet notes from the Grape Pie Bx genetics read clearly, with the Money Gun candy-gas depth providing the swagger that keeps the flavor from resolving into pure fruit candy. Money Gun is White Runtz x Gushers — two genetics that together contribute the contemporary candy-gas profile that dominates the current boutique flower market at its best. Gushers brings the warm, fruity gas. White Runtz brings the candy sweetness and the trichome density. The resulting Money Gun parent carries both simultaneously. Grape Pie Bx — Cherry Pie x Grape Stomper, with Granddaddy Purple running through the Grape Stomper lineage — contributes the dark grape sweetness, the cherry depth, and the indica body ease that grounds the candy-gas of the Money Gun parent. The combination is exactly what the Lunch Money name promises: something sweet, something specific, something that hits better than expected. Balanced 50/50 hybrid. Frost-caked colas. Myrcene as the dominant terpene, which means the grape-earthy-sweet character runs deep and settles rather than opening bright and fading. This is from our private Northern California small-batch farm. Limited quantity. Michael Z named it specifically alongside Thai for high terpene levels, fresh and sticky, and noted that he never coughs on the living soil flower. He is ordering again. Patsy B called the living soil AAA exotics top shelf. Lexus J found the store searching online for exotic THC flower and wants it to stay around for a really long time. BDA P walked in for the first time and was very pleased. Four consumers, four different entry points, the same conclusion. Purple Certz is Purple Punch x Zkittlez — two of the most celebrated candy-fruit genetics in the modern market crossing into something that earns its reputation through sustained repeat orders rather than a single impressive appearance. Purple Punch, Larry OG x Granddaddy Purple, brings the deep grape candy sweetness, the dark berry depth, the purple and violet coloration, and the relaxing indica body ease. Zkittlez, 3rd Gen Family and Terp Hogz’s Grape Ape x Grapefruit creation, adds the multi-layer tropical fruit complexity, the uplifting social energy, and the vibrant terpene architecture that makes Zkittlez-family crosses expressive across different consumer palates. The combination produces a profile that is simultaneously sweet, fruity, gassy, and dessert-forward without any single note dominating. The visual is the first thing. Candyland Strain THCa Flower — Living Soil Exotic AAA Candyland won the High Times Cannabis Cup in San Francisco in 2012. That was thirteen years ago. The fact that it is still worth growing, still worth seeking out, still sitting in the Living Soil Exotic AAA tier at a store that does not keep things on the shelf out of sentimentality — that is the whole argument for why genetics with a real lineage and a real competition history matter. The strain came from DNA Genetics working with 3rd Gen Family, crossing Grand Daddy Purple with Bay Platinum Cookies. The GDP side contributes the sweet candy terpene character, the sativa-dominant uplifting effect that runs counter to what GDP’s indica reputation would suggest, and the potential for purple coloration that develops in the right growing conditions. The Bay Platinum Cookies side contributes the fuel note, the skunky earth depth, and the potency ceiling that keeps the sativa energy from being purely airy. The combination produced an 80/20 sativa that hits fast, stays clean, and tastes like exactly what it is named after — candy with enough fuel underneath to remind you it is cannabis. Four people shot footage of this strain. @blazehydro reviewed it on YouTube. Three others followed. When consumers reach for a camera before they finish the first bowl, that is a specific kind of endorsement that no product description produces. Watch those: @blazehydro THCa Review | Additional Footage | Another Review | YouTube Short The living soil cultivation is what keeps Candyland worth growing in 2026. Most commercially available Candyland is grown in synthetic nutrient programs that produce the potency and the visual but flatten the terpene complexity. The sweet candy note and the fuel depth that make the strain’s flavor profile distinctive are both terpene-dependent qualities — they require the full biochemical complexity that a living soil microbial ecosystem supports rather than just the NPK ratios that synthetic programs deliver. All Hemp products have a matching COA on the product page so you can see potency and compliance. Afghani Strain THCa Flower — Indoor Special Ramiya ordered at night. It arrived the next morning. She tried it and wrote: “Honestly one of the best strains I’ve ever had. The flavor is earthy, the smoke was clean, and the effects were exactly what I wanted (sleepy, relaxed, euphoric). Definitely sticking to this landrace strain. I’ve tried many THCa flowers, this has gotta be the freshest and most potent medicine I’ve had.” She is only buying from Sherlocks now. That is both a store endorsement and a strain review from someone who has tried enough THCa flower to have a reference point worth trusting. Afghani is the same pure Hindu Kush landrace that appears in the Afghani Living Soil Exotic AAA — the genetics that built the Western cannabis industry, the pure indica that appears in the lineage of OG Kush, Blueberry, Northern Lights, and virtually every major hybrid in the last forty years. This is the Indoor Special version. Same genetics, controlled indoor environment, a different price point for buyers who want the Afghani experience without the AAA premium. What indoor cultivation provides for Afghani specifically is humidity management. Pure indica landraces with the compact, dense bud structure that Hindu Kush genetics produce are susceptible to moisture retention in variable humidity environments — the density that makes the visual so striking is also what makes precise drying and curing essential. Indoor precision keeps the moisture gradient consistent from the surface of the bud to the core, which is what produces the clean smoke that Ramiya specifically noted. Harsh smoke in indica-dominant flower almost always traces back to improper drying or residual moisture in dense bud structure. This does not have that problem. The earthy hash character that Ramiya described as exactly what she wanted is the myrcene and caryophyllene combination in Afghani genetics — the same compounds that produce the classic hash aroma the original plant was cultivated for in the Hindu Kush mountains. Alien Tsunami Strain THCa Flower – Living Soil Exotic AAA There is no entry for Alien Tsunami in the databases. No Leafly page. No Seedfinder listing. No breeder profile. This strain exists in one place — in the living soil beds of our new Southern Oregon micro farm partner — and now on our shelf. That’s not a gap in the data. That’s the point. Some of the best cannabis in the world doesn’t have a Wikipedia page. It has a farmer who has been watching it grow for years, taking notes no one else will ever read, and selecting for something that can’t be quantified on a lab report. Alien Tsunami is that strain. And what this farmer told us about growing it this run stopped us cold. From the Farmer — Notes on Alien Tsunami “This strain doesn’t grow — it arrives. What struck me most this run was the way Alien Tsunami handles stress. Every other plant in the room, when I’d do a heavy defoliation pass, would show a 36–48 hour recovery lag — you can read it in the leaves, a subtle drooping. Alien Tsunami showed zero lag. She didn’t flinch. She looked more vigorous the very next morning, like pruning her was the thing she’d been waiting for. I’ve started thinking of her as a strain with an almost accelerated biological memory — like she’s been genetically shaped by something that pruned her aggressively over generations and she rewired herself to thrive on it. The other thing — and I’ve never read this anywhere — is that her upper canopy colas and her lowermost popcorn buds smell completely different from each other on the same plant. The tops carry this electric, almost ozone-and-green-mango profile. But the lowers? Deep, slow, damp — like forest floor and overripe melon. Same plant, same soil, same light. Two completely different terpene stories depending on altitude within the canopy. I think light intensity is literally writing different chemical novels on the same genetic manuscript. Personal tasting note: First hit is almost aquatic — clean and weightless, like breathing near a cold river. Then it warms into something tropical and slightly metallic, like a copper bowl full of lychee. The transition between those two worlds is the whole experience.” –

That variation is what triggers the deepest purple expression in this genetics. Blue Razz Eclair Strain THCa Flower – Living Soil Exotic AAA Northern California Small Batch | Private Farm Drop Two distinct flavor references compressed into one strain name. Blue Razz is the sharp, tart blue raspberry candy note — the candy color that is not actually a real fruit but has become one of the most immediately recognizable flavor identities in American confectionery. An eclair is a pastry: choux dough exterior, cream filling, chocolate glaze. The combination in a strain name is doing something specific. Not “Blue Razz” with sweetness behind it. Blue Razz with a cream-filled pastry depth behind it. The tartness is the front. The eclair is what you find underneath. The Blue Razz family traces through Blue Cookies and Mendobreath UV and through Raspberry Kush-adjacent genetics to a Blueberry-descended foundation that gives the blue family its characteristic dark berry and blueberry depth. The specific Blue Razz Eclair expression adds the pastry and cream character to that foundation — a Cookies or Gelato-adjacent cross adding the doughy-sweet depth that turns a sharp berry candy profile into a dessert experience with layers. Berry above cream above dough. The specific tart sour note that makes blue raspberry candy immediately recognizable, resolved by a cream-filled finish. Indica-leaning hybrid. The berry brightness of the Blue Razz lineage delivers the initial mood elevation while the eclair-adjacent pastry genetics ground it in a settled, comfortable body experience. Not a racy sativa despite the bright candy opening. The opening is the sour blue raspberry hit. What it resolves into is the full eclair. From our private Northern California small-batch farm. Living soil. Limited quantity. Electric Kool Aid Strain THCa Flower — Indoor Special Tom Wolfe wrote The Electric Kool-Aid Acid Test in 1968 about Ken Kesey and the Merry Pranksters and the specific color that fluorescent paint and blacklight and San Francisco produced together. Periwinkle blue. Not purple. Not blue-purple. The specific shade that sits between them and catches light from across the room. The buds on this batch are that color. Purple Diesel x Cherry Pie — the GDP and Durban Poison genetics from the Cherry Pie side producing the anthocyanin expression, the diesel fuel lineage from Purple Diesel adding the gas depth, and the combination producing a visual that earns the name in a direct rather than metaphorical sense. Loyd H tried it and wrote one word: electrifying. Ekael N was honest — it did not look quite as colorful as the photo online, but the taste was incredible and it was the best he had tried from Sherlocks so far. That honesty is worth more than agreement would be. The color varies by batch and by how long ago it was harvested. The taste does not vary. The taste is what the genetics produce and what the indoor cultivation preserves. Purple Diesel contributes the hashy grape-lavender aroma, the diesel fuel note, and the uplifting sativa energy that keeps the experience moving rather than settling. Cherry Pie — Grand Daddy Purple x Durban Poison — adds the sweet cherry-berry character, the anthocyanin potential that produces the periwinkle visual, and enough indica ease to ground the Purple Diesel sativa without slowing it down. The combination is genuinely unusual in the way that strain names earned through association with cultural moments tend to be — weird, specific, and more coherent when you experience it than when you read the lineage. The indoor cultivation is what keeps the grape-cherry-diesel terpene combination intact through the full product life. Cherry Pie genetics carry linalool and myrcene that stabilize well under controlled conditions but fade quickly with temperature variation. Purple Diesel’s fuel character requires the same limonene and caryophyllene preservation that any diesel-forward genetics need from the post-harvest environment

Lemon Custard Strain THCa Flower — Living Soil Exotic AAA The lemon dessert category has been one of the fastest-growing segments of the current cannabis market, and most of it lands in one of two directions: either lemon-forward with a generic sweet background, or dessert-forward with a lemon note that disappears quickly. Lemon Custard is the version that holds both simultaneously rather than sacrificing one for the other — the custard character, the warm egg-and-vanilla depth that actual custard produces, sitting beneath a bright lemon peel top note that remains specific and vivid rather than fading into generic citrus. Lemon Custard’s lineage traces to a Lemon Tree or Lemon Skunk-adjacent parent crossed with a Cookies-family or Gelato-family dessert contributor — the specific pairing that multiple breeders have converged on independently because it is the combination most likely to produce the custard character rather than just lemon-sweet or just creamy-dessert. The Lemon Tree heritage carries a specific limonene-plus-myrcene combination that produces the bright-and-grounded citrus quality — not sharp and clean like pure limonene, but warm and slightly earthy in a way that reads as the lemon in a baked custard rather than fresh-squeezed juice. The Cookies or Gelato contribution adds the vanilla and cream base that the custard name requires. What makes Lemon Custard worth growing in living soil specifically is the myrcene component. The citrus is present in any cultivation environment. The custard warmth that justifies the name is what the living soil is producing. Maui Wowie Strain THCa Flower — Light Assist Michael got his order in about five days, tried the Maui Wowie alongside the White Widow, and was not let down compared to other vendors he had tried online. That review matters specifically because Michael named the strain — he was not reviewing the store in general or a different product, he was reviewing Maui Wowie specifically and decided it delivered. Maui Wowie has been in circulation since the 1970s. Hawaiian sativa landrace genetics, developed on the islands before most of the American cannabis market existed, selected over decades for the specific tropical fruit and citrus terpene profile and the clear, energetic, altitude-friendly high that became one of the most widely referenced cannabis experiences in the country. It has been imitated, diluted, and misrepresented on menus more than almost any other classic sativa. When it is the real genetics and it is grown correctly, the pineapple and mango note is specific and immediate — not tropical-adjacent, not citrus-forward with fruit described as tropical, but the actual Hawaiian sativa character that the original cultivars produced. Stephanie tried this batch and described a light fresh tropical smell and taste, then a hit of candy, then mint — ending in what she called eventual nirvana via a progression through calm, giggles, deep peace, and sustained tranquility throughout the body. Pure Michigan Strain THCa Flower — Living Soil Exotic AAA ThugPug Genetics and 3rd Coast Genetics are both based in Michigan. When they collaborated on Pure Michigan they were not just naming a strain after geography — they were making a claim about what Michigan cannabis breeding had become by the time this cross was developed. Oreoz crossed with Mendo Breath F2. Oreoz itself a Cookies N Cream x Secret Weapon cross with the cookie-and-cream dessert depth and the potency ceiling that made it one of the most sought-after Cookies-adjacent genetics of the last decade. Mendo Breath F2 — the stabilized second-generation selection that ThugPug had already used in Peanut Butter Breath — contributing the heavy frost, the earthy vanilla-caramel depth, and the deeply relaxing indica body effect that Mendo Breath genetics consistently deliver. The combination produced a strain that looked unlike most of what was on the market and tasted more complex than the visual suggested it would. The visual is the first thing. Dense, heavily frosted buds that one reviewer described as a storm cloud dipped in diamonds — an overstatement that lands correctly because the trichome density on Pure Michigan at full development is genuinely unusual. The frost is not distributed evenly across the surface in the way that most high-THC genetics produce it. It accumulates in layers, the older trichomes slightly amber at the base and the newer development building on top in clear crystal. The effect of looking at a well-grown Pure Michigan bud in direct light is specific and immediately memorable. The aroma is where the Michigan claim lands. Chocolate, coffee, nutty spice, and creamy vanilla with hints of citrus and diesel depending on the cut and cure. Not a single dominant note but a layered profile that builds as the jar warms — the vanilla and caramel arriving first from the Mendo Breath genetics, then the Oreoz cookie depth, then a sharp citrus-lime note from the limonene that cuts through the warmth and makes the whole profile more complex than any single descriptor captures. Purple Dream Strain THCa Flower — Indoor Special Two strains that need no introduction crossed into one that earns its own name. Granddaddy Purple is Ken Estes’s Purple Urkle x Big Bud cross from 2003 — one of the most visually striking and instantly recognizable indica expressions in American cannabis history, the deep purple-and-blue buds and grape candy aroma that became the visual reference for what premium indica looks like in a jar. Blue Dream is the Santa Cruz hybrid of DJ Short Blueberry and Super Silver Haze that became the most widely available sativa-dominant strain in California dispensaries for most of the 2010s — clear-headed, functional, berry and citrus sweet, the strain that converted more indica-only consumers to sativa than anything else in the modern market. Purple Dream takes the GDP grape sweetness and the Blue Dream cerebral clarity and runs them together. The result is described accurately in the meta description: calm without couch-lock. The GDP indica body ease arrives and stays, but the Blue Dream Haze genetics keep the headspace clear and present rather than pulling it down with the body. The grape and berry terpene profiles from both parents layer into something more complex than either delivers independently — the GDP linalool and the Blue Dream’s terpinolene sit in the same profile at the same time and the combination reads as purple berry and sweet fruit with a citrus note from the Haze genetics that keeps it from being purely dessert. The indoor cultivation handles the GDP genetics correctly — Granddaddy Purple’s dense, moisture-retentive bud structure needs humidity management that indoor cultivation provides consistently. The deep purple and blue coloration that makes GDP crosses visually distinctive develops under controlled temperature variation, and indoor environments provide that variation in a predictable way rather than leaving it to ambient weather conditions. The visual on Purple Dream reflects the GDP anthocyanin genetics expressing correctly in a well-managed indoor environment. Watch the Purple Dream review on YouTube . Street Tarts Strain THCa Flower – Living Soil Exotic AAA Northern California Small Batch | Private Farm Drop Purple City Genetics built Street Tarts from Guava Tart and Street Guru, and the cross landed in a specific territory between tropical fruit candy and gas-forward pastry that most strains named after confectionery never actually reach. Guava Tart brings the guava funk and tropical tartness. Street Guru brings the street-level gas depth and the urban edge that the name implies. Together they produce something that is genuinely tart in the way fruit candy is tart rather than the way generic “candy” strains approximate it — the citrus and tropical notes have an actual sour bite before the sweetness resolves. The visual is what consumers consistently mention first. Glittering purple buds drenched in resinous trichomes, with a trichome architecture dense enough to reflect light. The purple coloration develops from the genetics rather than temperature stress — it is an expression of the anthocyanin compounds in the Guava Tart genetics rather than a manipulation of the environment to force color. That distinction matters in living soil cultivation: the color is the plant’s own response to the genetics under conditions that support full secondary metabolite expression. The terpene profile runs tropical, gas, and pastry simultaneously — a nose that opens with guava and tropical citrus tartness, then shifts to the Street Guru gas depth, then settles on something warm and slightly doughy underneath. That progression is what earns the “tarts” reference: a candy that opens sweet-tart and resolves to something with body. Indica-leaning hybrid. Cerebral euphoria arriving first, body weight building. This is from our private Northern California small-batch program — limited quantity, grown in living soil, not a rotating catalog item. The knock on most sativa-forward flower is that it runs too fast, too cerebral, too much edge without enough ease. Trop Cherry, as it’s known in the market, was built to solve exactly that problem. Relentless Genetics crossed Tropicana Cookies with Cherry Cookies F3 and the result is a sativa-dominant hybrid that leads with bright, joyful citrus energy and lands in something genuinely comfortable rather than wired. The nose opens with ripe cherry and fresh orange simultaneously — a combination that shouldn’t work as cleanly as it does. Tangerine zest and sweet cookie dough build underneath, then a clean pine finish arrives at the back that keeps the whole profile from being one-dimensional. The smoke is smooth. The high is uplifting, creative, and functional. You stay in the world rather than floating above it. This is our Light Assist tier — greenhouse grown with real natural sunlight and supplemental lighting to extend the cycle and support terpene development. What we have noticed specifically about Tropicana Cherry Cookies in light assist cultivation is that the cherry terpene expression develops more fully under natural light than it does in full indoor. The Cherry Cookies F3 genetics carry a dark-fruit depth that requires real photon variation across the day to fully unlock. Consistent artificial spectrum tends to flatten it into generic sweetness. The greenhouse variation — morning light building through midday, softening into afternoon — pulls the cherry out of the background and puts it front and center alongside the citrus. The result is a fruit profile that is genuinely three-dimensional in a way that makes this Light Assist product punch above its tier. The grower who supplies this run has been phenotype hunting in the Trop Cherry genetics specifically for dark-fruit expression for two seasons. The current selection was chosen for the depth of the cherry note on the exhale rather than just visual bag appeal. That priority shows in the smoke. Trop

Yum Berry Strain THCa Flower — Living Soil Exotic AAA Also known as: Blueberry Yum Yum Blueberry Yum Yum has a name that predates the strain. Ludacris released the song in 2001, named after the specific sweet blueberry candy character that DJ Short’s Blueberry genetics produce when they are grown correctly — a flavor reference so specific and so recognizable that it became cultural vocabulary before anyone formalized it as a strain name. The strain named itself after the song, or the song named itself after the flavor, depending on which version of the story you prefer. Either way, when the genetics actually deliver on the name, the reference makes immediate sense. Blueberry x Durban Poison is a cross we carry in two expressions — Bali Berry and Yum Berry — because the same genetic combination produces meaningfully different phenotype expressions depending on which parent’s character dominates. Bali Berry leans toward the Durban Poison’s tropical-island brightness — the terpinolene and ocimene expression that produces the lychee-mango-adjacent complexity that distinguishes the strain from standard berry crosses. Yum Berry leans toward the Blueberry side — the linalool-forward DJ Short expression that produces the specific sweet blueberry candy note the song and the strain are both named after. Same genetics, different phenotype selection, genuinely different terpene experience. The Yum Berry phenotype was selected specifically for the Blueberry Yum Yum character — the concentrated, slightly artificial-sweet blueberry that the linalool-dominant Blueberry expression produces at its most extreme. This is not fresh blueberry or blueberry jam. It is the specific candy version of blueberry that appears in the Blueberry genetics when the linalool accumulation reaches a certain threshold. Thomas Watson described a happy, euphoric high that tastes great and looks great. That combination — the candy-sweet terpene profile producing a euphoric balanced experience — is exactly what the Blueberry Yum Yum phenotype selection was designed to deliver. The living soil cultivation does specific work with the DJ Short Blueberry genetics that is worth understanding.
